exposure: implementation of 2019 European Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) guidelines
cohort: The study included 593 very preterm infants born before 32 gestational weeks between January 1st, 2018 and December 31st, 2021.
finding: The implementation of 2019 European RDS guidelines significantly decreased the overall incidence of bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD) and extrauterine growth retardation (EUGR) in very preterm infants, though not in subgroups of infants less than 28 gestational weeks or less than 1,000g.
birth_weight: N/A (subgroup of infants less than 1,000g analyzed)
gest_age: before 32 gestational weeks (subgroup of infants less than 28 gestational weeks analyzed)
